summary: The implementation provides a comprehensive KAYSEN Botanical Luxury showcase website with stop-motion aesthetics. All major requirements are implemented including Hero, Unveiling, Focus, Wave, Product Details, and Editions sections with mechanical animations and audio synchronization. However, REQ-1 (design specification documentation) is not explicitly implemented as a separate document, and the color palette implementation differs from the specified emerald/botanical greens/luxury gold theme.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create a comprehensive design specification documenting the stop-motion aesthetic, including color palette (deep emerald, botanical greens, luxury gold accents), typography choices, animation timing principles (mechanical, ratcheted movements), and interaction patterns (scroll-triggered sequences, spring physics)
missing_requirements.reason: While the implementation includes all technical elements (colors, typography, animations), there is no separate design specification document. The color system is implemented in code (frontend/src/index.css) but not documented as a comprehensive specification with rationale and guidelines.

hallucinated_features.description: Footer component with social media links (X/Twitter, Instagram) and caffeine.ai attribution
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly lists non-goals and constraints but does not request a footer section with social media links. While attribution may be reasonable, social media integration was not specified.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend actor with Internet Identity authentication hooks
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly states 'User authentication or accounts' as a non-goal, yet backend/main.mo, useActor.ts, and useInternetIdentity.ts implement authentication infrastructure.
